data.name: Isbaat
data.gender_notes: Isbaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘as-sabahah’, which means ‘to announce good news’. This name is rooted in the concept of spreading positivity and joy, and is often given to a child born after a long wait or difficult struggle. The name Isbaat carries the meaning “Announcement, Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Isbaat usually hope their child will grow to embody announcement, good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of good news, bearer of joy and positivity
data.etymology: Isbaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Announcement, Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isbaat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
